description: Na₂ReO₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/mcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. Re⁴⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O²⁻ atoms. All Re-O bond lengths are 1.83 Å. O²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one Re⁴⁺ atom.
